scope: 60 main-course lessons A1–C1; local review only

lessons.title: Meet Vanya
lessons.instruction: Watch the introductions, then answer the questions
lessons.focus: Introductions, context and a personal reply

questions.prompt: What’s the man’s name?
questions.hint: Listen for “I’m…” after Vanya asks about Paul
questions.answer: His name is Emir

questions.prompt: Where are they?
questions.hint: Look at the room and listen for the place Emir names
questions.answer: They’re at an office

questions.prompt: What does Yuna say to welcome Vanya?
questions.hint: Listen to Yuna’s last words
questions.answer: She says “Welcome to the team”

questions.prompt: You meet Vanya. How do you introduce yourself?
questions.hint: Start with Hi, then say your name
questions.answer: Example: Hi, Vanya! I’m [your name]. Nice to meet you

lessons.title: Ask to hear it again
lessons.instruction: Watch how Paul asks Bob to repeat, then practise checking a name
lessons.focus: Clarification and polite question rhythm

questions.prompt: What does Bob need?
questions.hint: Listen for the tool Bob repeats
questions.answer: He needs the hammer

questions.prompt: Why can’t Paul hear him well?
questions.hint: Listen to Paul’s first explanation
questions.answer: His ears are blocked

questions.prompt: How does Paul ask Bob to speak more slowly?
questions.hint: Listen for repeat and slowly
questions.answer: He says, “Could you repeat that more slowly, please?”

questions.prompt: Your teacher says a name too quickly. What can you say?
questions.hint: Ask for repetition politely
questions.answer: Example: Could you say that again more slowly, please?

questions.hint: Say the relationship and one fact
questions.answer: Example: This is my sister. She’s a student
